purpose: Restore away-facing head angle with eyes fully hidden by hair.

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the selected transparent mermaid sprite to edit. Image 2 is the exact original SLEVEJM2 014 pose and gesture. Image 3 is the established adult mermaid identity, palette and hand-inked cel-shaded style reference only. Rotate her head and shoulders AWAY from the camera into the same rear three-quarter left-facing angle seen in this sequence. Bring the forward sweep of golden hair fully across the bowed face so BOTH EYES are completely covered by hair. No eye, pupil, sclera, eyelash or eyebrow may be visible through or around the hair. Show mainly the back/side of her head and hair, with only a small lower-face silhouette if needed. Preserve the near arm's low bent elbow and horizontal forearm reaching toward screen-left with its small curled hand; do not lift that hand to her face. Keep the far arm hidden. Preserve turquoise headband, green swimsuit, torso, waterline, proportions, colors, bold black ink and restrained cel shading. No extra arm or hand. Preserve clear margins and genuine transparent RGBA. No background, checkerboard, glow, shadow, text or submerged anatomy.
